description: Offline. How to get what the user sends: native USDC (not USDC.e) plus a little ETH for gas on Arbitrum One (u2x, default), or XMR in their own wallet (x2u). Pass from {chain, asset} (and amount) for one ordered checklist: quote, fund, re-quote (requoteOf).

amount.description: Send amount from a quote, if known.

direction.description: u2x (default): the user sends USDC. x2u: XMR.

chain.description: arbitrum, ethereum, another chain, or exchange (or its name).

name: get_funding_options
title: How to fund a swap
